Often called the Chinese Hogwarts, the Hebei Academy of Fine Arts is a real art university located in Xinle, in Hebei Province, China. Its impressive European style architecture features grand castles, towering spires, stone walls and buildings that look like they belong in the world of Harry Potter. Despite its magical appearance, this is not an amusement park or a movie set, but an actual educational institution where students study art and develop their creative skills. The campus has become famous online for its fairytale atmosphere, making it one of the most unusual looking university campuses in China. #China #Architecture #Hogwarts #Universities #Travel
